searchText: 1. zkCasper 2. I have same question lol Anyone have more light clients that im missing here? 2. It was briefly presented by <@881905303011086387> today at ACDC 130 (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/987#issuecomment-2012282610) . Would need some stronger signal from the community to push devs into merging + implementing. The case was also made today about it in conjunction with maxEB benefits. There was a very brief discussion on it and without understanding the timelines of zkSync, it's still up for debate how relevant the sync committee will be up until that point. The longer we keep delaying these changes, the more irrelevant it will be once other solutions are ready imo. Anybody in the community that relies on this protocol should review the newest spec here by Etan and signal for it: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8340. This includes the light client backfill: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8341 how is zksync relevant to what Ethereum is doing? What other solutions are in the works? Super intriguing! Oops sorry I meant efforts in R&D to ZK the finality aspect of FFG. But it's currently unknown where those efforts are at, so these proposals from Etan are useful for today and the near future. More context from the call here: https://www.youtube.com/live/3rRJ1H0MJDY?si=HuVY60RXYFDZdHHF&t=4753 thank you! so anyone know if this project went anywhre? https://research.polytope.technology/zkcasper Are there others?
